tasks.old_behavior: `write_midx_file_only()` accepted 5 parameters (source, packs_to_include, preferred_pack_name, refs_snapshot, flags). `write_midx_file_compact()` accepted 4 parameters (source, from, to, flags). Neither accepted an `incremental_base` parameter.
tasks.new_behavior: Both `write_midx_file_only()` and `write_midx_file_compact()` now accept a new `const char *incremental_base` parameter at position 4 (before `flags`). `write_midx_file_only` now has 6 parameters; `write_midx_file_compact` now has 5 parameters.
tasks.compatibility_reason: `midx.h` is a public header (matched by `public_library_headers` surface in the git profile). Any external code that includes `midx.h` and calls `write_midx_file_only()` or `write_midx_file_compact()` will fail to compile due to the missing parameter. The parameter is inserted before `flags`, so existing callers passing positional arguments will have their arguments misaligned. All in-tree callers (builtin/multi-pack-index.c, midx-write.c) have been updated in the same patch, but external callers linking against git's internal libraries will break.
tasks.test_recommendation: Run t5334-incremental-multi-pack-index.sh and t5335-compact-multi-pack-index.sh to verify that `write_midx_file_only` and `write_midx_file_compact` work correctly with and without the new `--base` / `incremental_base` parameter. These tests already cover the new `--base` option behavior.
